newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-KLAIPEDOS NAFTA HANDLES LESS IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-KLAIPEDOS NAFTA HANDLES LESS IN APRIL.

text.p: Lithuania's Klaipedos Nafta oil terminal said on Monday it reloaded 145,000 tonnes of oil products in April, 118,000 tonnes less than in March.
"Turnover decreased last month since Russia exported less because of low prices for oil products on the world's market," Elena Cherinij, finance manager, told Reuters.
She also said that the beginning of May showed a radical change in the situation and the company was expecting a rise in volumes this month.
"We plan that the company's volume of reloaded oil products in May might be up around three times compared to the results of April," Chernij said.
The company has reported a nine million litas net profit for the first quarter of 1997.
